question: ‘Cracking the Code: My Journey to Bollywood’ is the autobiography of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is** Ayushmann Khurana.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​Ayushmann Khurrana **is an award-winning Indian film actor, singer and television anchor.
 
• **In Cracking the Code, Ayushmann Khurrana** actor, singer and television personality outlines a step-by-step guide to making it big.
 
• He is the recipient of several awards, including** a National Film Award and four Filmfare.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn01.sapnaonline.com/product_media/9788129135681/md_9788129135681.jpg] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **​Rajkumar Rao** is an Indian actor known for his work in Hindi films.
 
• **Amit Sadh** is an Indian actor.
 
 
• He is known for his roles in films like Kai Po Che, Guddu Rangeela, and sarkar 3.
 
 
 
• **Sushant Singh Rajput** was an Indian Actor known for his work in Hindi films.
